Description
UWA was established in 1911 and is the sixth-oldest university in Australia. It is in the Group of Eight and according to the Melbourne Institute Index is ranked second in Australia for the quality of its undergraduate programs.The Foundation and Diploma pathway courses, delivered at Taylors College Perth, provides the academic and English language skills required to successfully progress onto a degree at The University of Western Australia.
